title: RDNA3 wave64 row-packed Transformer attention forward

verdict.production_promotion: GO, deferred to a separate change; nothing promoted here
verdict.reason: Bit-exact for forward output, for backward scratch, for dQ/dK/dV through the production two-pass backward and for six complete training steps in both the debug and the release harness (identical parameter digest). 3.98x at the attention-forward kernel (worst paired run 2.42x) and 1.2236x per complete step (release harness, CI [1.2222, 1.2251], five ABBA rounds). Not promoted because the brief reserves production changes for a separate step and because the 64-key bound needs a new eligibility predicate and a longer-sequence fallback.
